name: social-autoposter
tagline_zh: 发帖总忘？Reddit、X、LinkedIn、Moltbook 一键同步。它还会自己找话题、回评论、盯数据。
tagline_en: Post to Reddit, X, LinkedIn & Moltbook in one go. It hunts threads, replies, and tracks stats—your tireless.
desc_en: Automate social media posting across Reddit, X/Twitter, LinkedIn, and Moltbook. Find threads, post comments, create original posts, track engagement stats. Use when: 'post to social', 'social autoposter', 'find threads to comment on', 'create a post', 'audit social posts', 'update post stats'.
why_zh: 同类只会定时发，它却能主动嗅探相关讨论并插入评论，连互动数据都自动回填，省掉你手动盯盘的功夫。
why_en: Unlike schedulers, it actively finds relevant threads, posts comments, and auto-updates engagement stats—no manual tracking.
